title: Weeping Angel
description: Adds the weeping angel origin to minecraft with the origins mod!
body:
Weeping Angel Impact: 3

"Blink and you're dead."
As a cursed, living statue, you can move at terrifying speeds when unseen but are powerless under direct observation.

Powers:
৹Blink|
You are able to relocate instanteniously
to the location you are looking.

Passives:

৹Supernatural|
When not being looked at by players you are extremly powerful and fast.

৹Carved Statue|
You have all of the perks and disadvantages of a stone statue.
+ you do not need to eat
+ you have no lungs
+ you don't take knockback
- you sink in water
- you can only heal by using STONE

Weaknesses:

৹Quantum Lock|
You instantly turn into a statue when someone is actively looking at you.
(has to be a player)


------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------





Adds the weeping angel origin to minecraft with the origins mod!

This origin requires the 1.20.2 version of apugli!
[https://modrinth.com/mod/apugli/version/2.10.3+1.20.2-fabric]
